faqs.question: How close is the hotel to Lalibela's rock-hewn churches?
faqs.answer: We are a short walk from the main church paths, and our reception team can arrange a trusted local guide for your morning visit.

faqs.question: Are meals and traditional coffee ceremonies available?
faqs.answer: Yes. Daily breakfast is included, and guests can reserve dinner and traditional coffee ceremonies in the courtyard.

faqs.question: Do you provide Lalibela Airport shuttle service?
faqs.answer: Yes, share your arrival flight with us and our hotel vehicle will meet you at Lalibela Airport.

faqs.question: Can we book multiple rooms together for a tour group?
faqs.answer: Yes, send us your group size and travel dates through Contact Us and we will reserve courtyard rooms side by side.

newsPosts.title: Evening Stone Terrace Opens for Dinner Guests
newsPosts.excerpt: Dine under the clear Lalibela night sky with local dishes and fresh honey wine.
newsPosts.body:
Our newly finished stone terrace overlooks the quiet eastern valley of Lalibela.

Guests can reserve traditional Ethiopian platters and warm spiced tea beside courtyard lanterns.
newsPosts.author: Selam Tadesse

newsPosts.title: Daily Coffee Ceremony Now Included for Weekend Stays
newsPosts.excerpt: Relax in the courtyard pavilion every afternoon with freshly roasted Ethiopian coffee.
newsPosts.body:
Every Friday through Sunday, guests are invited to gather in our sheltered garden courtyard for a traditional buna ceremony.

We serve fresh beans alongside warm kocho bread and roasted barley.
newsPosts.author: Guest Relations

newsPosts.title: Trusted Airport Transfers from Lalibela Airport
newsPosts.excerpt: Easy 25-minute drive from arrivals directly to your courtyard room.
newsPosts.body:
Our hotel drivers track incoming daily flights so there is never a wait at the terminal.

Just add your flight time when messaging our desk.
newsPosts.author: Reception Desk

blogPosts.title: Visiting Lalibela's Rock-Hewn Churches at Sunrise
blogPosts.excerpt: Why early morning is the calmest time to explore the stone pathways and courtyards.
blogPosts.body:
Walking through Lalibela just after sunrise lets you hear morning chants echo gently across the ancient carved courtyards before daytime crowds arrive.

Have hot tea and honey bread on our terrace at 6:30 AM, then join our local guide for a relaxed five-minute stroll down to the first church gate.
blogPosts.author: Abebe Worku

blogPosts.title: Seasonal Ethiopian Meals from Local Highlands
blogPosts.excerpt: Warm stews, fresh teff injera, and local white honey served in our courtyard dining room.
blogPosts.body:
Good travel memories often start around the dinner table.

Our kitchen partners with surrounding farming families in Lasta to bring fresh teff, garden greens, and golden highland honey to evening service alongside quiet candlelight.
blogPosts.author: Almaz Belay

blogPosts.title: Planning Your Stay Around Ethiopian Holidays & Timkat
blogPosts.excerpt: How far ahead to reserve rooms during Genna, Timkat, and busy harvest travel months.
blogPosts.body:
Lalibela comes alive during Christmas (Genna) and Epiphany (Timkat) with peaceful white-robed processions and warm hospitality throughout town.

Booking your courtyard room early ensures quiet rest just steps from the celebrations.
blogPosts.author: Yonas Getahun
